sections.overview:
Telegram-Marketing-Tools is a comprehensive automation platform offering nearly 50 functions designed for Telegram marketing workflows. Core capabilities include member addition, user scraping, bulk direct messaging, message forwarding, and API ID generation. Built and maintained by nornac, this tool streamlines repetitive Telegram marketing tasks through integrated automation features.
Automate member recruitment across Telegram groups and channels at scale
Extract user data from Telegram communities for targeted marketing campaigns
Send mass direct messages to prospect lists without manual effort
Forward messages across multiple channels to amplify content reach
